patterns.note: The site employs a minimalist, airy layout with generous whitespace, featuring full-bleed hero and product imagery balanced with structured text blocks and grid-based product listings.
A sophisticated serif font is used for the brand logo and key section titles, contrasted with a clean, small sans-serif for body text, navigation, and uppercase section labels.
The primary color palette is dominated by off-white and light beige backgrounds, with dark grey and black text, allowing product photography to introduce the main bursts of color.

The hero section features a full-bleed video that plays on a loop and scrolls up and out of view as the user scrolls down, acting as a large visual introduction. The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.
The footer is designed as an extensive 'INDEX' section, presenting a multi-column grid of navigation links and information, rather than a compact, traditional footer.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video is used as the hero element, playing on a continuous loop. This large video section is designed to scroll upwards with the page content, gradually revealing subsequent content sections below it.
The main header navigation is implemented to remain fixed at the top of the browser window, ensuring constant access to site navigation and branding elements as the user scrolls.
Product displays alternate between simple, clean grids for multiple items and large, editorial-style image-text pairings for featured products, emphasizing high-quality photography.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant serif headings are moderately larger than the small, clean sans-serif body text, with uppercase sans-serif labels used for section titles.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly rectangular elements and product images, with minimal rounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous whitespace around sections and elements, particularly in the hero and product showcases, creating a sense of luxury and calm).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed, looping video hero that scrolls away to reveal content, combined with an extensive, grid-based 'INDEX' footer, creates a sophisticated and editorial feel that prioritizes visual storytelling and comprehensive navigation. The minimalist aesthetic allows the product photography to truly shine.
